scope: Scarlet Invocation phrase feel and crossflow seals: only key moments land exactly on bar heads (crossflow and cluster releases, pickups at each Act's combat downbeat, the Final drop and after a chorus, a signature move's final step, bar-head chorus calls and verdicts); three syncopated eighth-grid notes per phrase replace four strikes on four consecutive beats; signature steps a dotted quarter apart; impact-only ordinary notes; the crossflow stream's round ends stop at the seal centres, the seals are drawn over the live stream and the pair may reach a field wall; separate target rotations for crossflows and other aimed notes
target_build: 0.3.81 / protocol80 (feat/scarlet-feel on main dc14559, 0.3.80; 0.3.79 is taken by the open feat/scarlet-attack-expression branch, #112)
owner_feedback: 2026-10-03, after playing main 0.3.78: the stream between the two seals visibly ran over and past them; the raid leaned too hard into rhythm-game feel and should give a satisfying hit on the music only at key moments. The same report noted the Scarlet Covenant's missing item icon, already fixed on main by #113 (0.3.80) and included in this build
design_process: two drafts (musical phrasing, readable minimal) reviewed by three judges; synthesis: the minimal draft's two-bar skeleton and wall clamp, the musical draft's crossflow geometry (forecast band unchanged, live capsule inside it), pickups at the downbeats where nothing else releases, an issue rule that keeps the curtain's observation one look-ahead before its first step, and separate aim rotations

timing.ordinary_phrase: two bars from a bar head; three notes (cells in beats: serial % 3 == 1 at 3, 4.5, 6; == 2 at 3.5, 5, 6; Final == 0 at 3, 5, 6), each warned one measured beat earlier, never on a bar head, at least a beat apart; the closing crossflow warns on beat 6 (the third note's strike) and releases on beat 8, the next phrase's downbeat, collapsing two beats later
timing.pickup: where no closer releases on the phrase's downbeat (an Act's first phrase, after a chorus or an unlatched cycle boundary, or a phrase that had to move): a crossflow (Final: cluster orb) warns two beats before the bar head and releases on it; Pulse 9. Signature phrases never take one
timing.signature_phrase: four steps at beats 3.5, 5, 6.5 and 8 (the next downbeat, in the crossflow's place, accent 2); no closer
timing.chorus: called on the first bar head at or after its request, verdict on the bar head eight beats later, end one bar after; the next phrase's pickup releases on that end
timing.issue: a phrase is booked on a bar head and issued LookAheadTicks (30) before its first forecast, not before its bar head; a stalled runtime moves it to the next feasible bar with a pickup

geometry.seals: centre of the pair = Target.X clamped to Left + 470 .. Right - 470 (was 580), so a seal centre may sit on a field wall; seals 940 px apart, unchanged size
geometry.forecast: Side(forecast) is the seal-centre-to-seal-centre band, drawn by CrimsonEnergy as a capless veil exactly as before
geometry.live: one capsule from the right seal growing left: front = right - 940 * reach, radius = min(140 * width, (right - front) / 2), segment (right - radius) .. (front + radius); its round ends never pass the seal centres and it lies inside the forecast band; ScarletInk draws and CrimsonGesture collides this capsule
geometry.draw_order: while charging the seals lie under the forecast veil as before; while live, the ink is drawn and then the seals and vapor over it
geometry.wall: a 20 px body pressed against a wall on the stream's line is hit; it must leave the line by 93 px there instead of 161 px in the open (the round end's half-height at the wall)

sound: CrimsonGestureVisuals: crossflow and cluster charge/release unchanged; ordinary notes play only ScarletImpact on Fire (the ScarletForetell on every warning is gone); a signature move plays ScarletForetell on its first and final step's warning and ScarletImpact on every step; gain 1.0 and the owner-approved files unchanged
targeting: server-only: one ordinal per aimed note identity (Final's two families of a note share it), crossflows and other aimed notes rotating separately through the living roster
rope_parity: RopeIsLow flipped: odd steps (including the final step on the downbeat) sweep the floor, so grounded players jump on the downbeat

measured_properties.curtain_base: from any x in the observed column, running toward the open side from step 0's warning: smallest clearance 41.8 px (protocol79 40.2); from the column centre starting at step 1's warning: 155.2 px (74.2); tolerated drift from the centre at step 0's warning: 284 px against and 284 px along the walk (158 / 284)
measured_properties.curtain_look_ahead: observed 30 ticks before step 0's warning: at rest, standing or accelerating the wrong way through the look-ahead, every 1 px start in every column survives (smallest clearance 4.2 px); already running away from the open side at full base speed, only the trailing 92 px of an interior column fail (1,104 of 2,844 one-pixel starts over columns 2-7 and two phrases), against 2,616 for the protocol79 timing, which also lost 1,464 starts that merely accelerated away
measured_properties.rope: unchanged per step: no height safe on both combs, the ceiling transition needs 24 of 28 ticks, farthest move 112.5 px; each comb's live window now ends before the next comb is shown
measured_properties.hands: unchanged per step: ENDGAME smallest clearance 12.4 px, BASE -27.8 px (endgame assumption kept)
measured_properties.density: an Act cycle has 48 attacks plus pickups instead of 60 (24 ordinary notes, 16 signature steps, 8 closing crossflows), the crossflow-or-finale downbeats being 8 closers plus pickups and 4 signature finales instead of 12 crossflows
